This software is a computer program whose purpose is to provide an extension of the BCM component model that aims to define a components tailored for cyber-physical control systems (CPCS) for Java.

This package defines accelerated clocks for BCM4JavaCyphy. It adds to the plain accelerated clocks of BCM4Java the capability to manage both the code execution time line and the simulation time line put in parallel.
